name: Workbench GNOME selected session incarnation and exact native focus
testName: private GNOME Shell renders actors and handles real seat keyboard, pointer and nested dismissal
plane: Private GNOME 46 virtual seat, fixture PUI, current source build
summary: The retained final v5 run passed 33 assertions. A selected owner whose roster session changes from 4242 to 4243 is refused without changing terminal focus. After restoring session 4242, activation focuses its exact GTK window rather than session 42420 in the same process with a similar title. Both fixture window actors are mapped before one distractor activation. No fresh-key or second-activation workaround is used.
